description: LihFolk Roblox check: scans every .lua/.luau file Claude writes or edits for well-known Roblox mistakes (deprecated APIs, unvalidated remotes, unsafe DataStore and ProcessReceipt code, leaks, client-owned currency) and feeds the findings back so Claude fixes them. One command line runs the POSIX sh engine under bash/sh and the PowerShell engine under PowerShell; see hooks/README.md.

hooks.command: echo `# <#` >/dev/null; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/lihfolk-check.sh"; exit $? #> >$null; powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/lihfolk-check.ps1"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
